coverage: Normal daily run, Friday 11 Sep 2026 ~07:02-07:45 SGT, one session after the 10 Sep catch-up run. Latest COMPLETED US session is Thu 10 Sep (NY currently 19:02, just after that close). HK/SG closed 10 Sep too; JP/KR's own index data is a session behind (consolidates late, not a holiday). Thursday was a hot-PPI risk-off day with three genuinely distinct, decoupled catalysts on the same session: August PPI ran in-line on the monthly headline (+0.4%) but hot on annual terms (+5.4% y/y), pushing Sep 15-16 FOMC hike odds from ~60% to ~70% and hitting gold/silver miners hard via the real-yield channel (SLV -5.30%, GDX -3.46%, Barrick -6.99%); the Hormuz war separately escalated to its largest attack wave yet (Iran claimed strikes on 10 vessels), keeping oil spiking (Brent toward $108-109) the SAME session gold sold off; and the rare-earth basket sold off on a third, distinct catalyst -- reports of a possible Trump-Xi Washington summit reducing the perceived 'China-decoupling premium' (MP -5.49%, USAR -4%, REMX -5%). Equities fell only modestly (S&P -0.58%) but VIX spiked 8.38% to 17.84, and CNN Fear&Greed fell further to 33/Fear (from 36) while crypto Fear&Greed rose to 69/Greed (from 66) -- a widening sentiment divergence. Today's (11 Sep) CPI print is the decisive next data point into next week's FOMC.
tldr: August PPI ran hot on annual terms (+5.4% y/y) even though the monthly headline was in-line, pushing Sep 15-16 FOMC hike odds from ~60% to ~70% -- today's CPI is the decisive follow-through print.

Gold and silver miners were routed on the real-yield reaction (SLV -5.30%, GDX -3.46%, Barrick -6.99%) even though the Hormuz safe-haven case stayed intact -- Kitco called it metals 'trading as a rates-and-dollar market, not a clean safe-haven market' right now, and the pullback-vs-reversal read is genuinely disputed.

The Hormuz/Iran war escalated to its largest attack wave yet (Iran claims strikes on 10 vessels) the SAME session gold sold off -- oil (Brent toward $108-109) and gold decoupled cleanly, confirming these are two distinct trades right now.

The rare-earth watchlist (MP, USA Rare Earth, Lynas, Energy Fuels) sold off on a third, separate catalyst -- reports a Trump-Xi Washington summit could be scheduled later in Sept, seen as reducing the ex-China 'decoupling premium' -- even as USA Rare Earth broke ground on a $1.2bn South Carolina facility the same day.

US equities fell only modestly (S&P -0.58%) but VIX spiked 8.38% to 17.84 and CNN Fear&Greed fell further to 33/Fear, while crypto Fear&Greed rose to 69/Greed -- a widening, not narrowing, sentiment divergence heading into today's CPI.
